# Function reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Catalog

Finding out what the repositories publish.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [list](list.qmd#labdata.list) | Tabulate what the configured repositories publish. |
| [repos](repos.qmd#labdata.repos) | Tabulate one row per repository that publishes something. |
| [versions](versions.qmd#labdata.versions) | Tabulate the history of one published file or dataset. |
| [refresh](refresh.qmd#labdata.refresh) | Rescan the repositories and store the catalog. |
| [frame](frame.qmd#labdata.frame) | Represent the catalog as a data frame. |
| [catalog](catalog.qmd#labdata.catalog) | Get the catalog, rescanning only when needed. |
| [build](build.qmd#labdata.build) | Catalog every repository under the configured roots. |
| [diagnose](diagnose.qmd#labdata.diagnose) |     Explain why a scan found nothing. |

## Fetching

Getting a local path to one version of a result file.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [get](get.qmd#labdata.get) | Download one result file, addressed by repository and file name. |
| [fetch](fetch.qmd#labdata.fetch) | Get a local path to a result file, fetching it if it is not cached. |
| [outdated](outdated.qmd#labdata.outdated) | Say whether a pinned version has been overtaken. |

## Resolving

Turning a spec such as `repo:file@version` into one entry and one
version.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [resolve_one](resolve_one.qmd#labdata.core.resolve_one) | Find the single entry a spec refers to. |
| [match](match.qmd#labdata.core.match) | Find the entries a spec refers to, ignoring its version. |
| [selects](selects.qmd#labdata.core.selects) | Test whether a narrowed scan should look at a repository. |
| [find_version](find_version.qmd#labdata.core.find_version) | Resolve a version reference against a file's history. |
| [fingerprint](fingerprint.qmd#labdata.core.fingerprint) | Summarise the settings that decide what a catalog contains. |
| [scan_repo](scan_repo.qmd#labdata.core.scan_repo) | Catalog the result files of one repository. |
| [repo_identity](repo_identity.qmd#labdata.core.repo_identity) | Determine the owner and name of a repository. |
| [materialize](materialize.qmd#labdata.core.materialize) | Place one version of a result file in the cache and return its path. |
| [progress_bar](progress_bar.qmd#labdata.core.progress_bar) | Wrap an iterable in a progress bar when one is wanted. |
| [copy_out](copy_out.qmd#labdata.core.copy_out) | Write a copy of a cached file where the caller asked for it. |

## Data types

What the catalog is made of.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Entry](Entry.qmd#labdata.Entry) | A result file in a repository, at its most recent version. |
| [Version](Version.qmd#labdata.Version) | One commit in which a result file changed. |
| [Spec](Spec.qmd#labdata.Spec) | A parsed reference to a result file. |

## GitHub

Cataloguing and fetching repositories over the GitHub API, without
cloning them.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [build](build.qmd#labdata.remote.build) | Catalog every repository the settings name on GitHub. |
| [scan_repo](scan_repo.qmd#labdata.remote.scan_repo) | Catalog the result files one GitHub repository publishes. |
| [versions](versions.qmd#labdata.remote.versions) | List every version of one published file or dataset on GitHub. |
| [version_at](version_at.qmd#labdata.remote.version_at) | Read one named version of a file on GitHub without listing the others. |
| [dataset_files](dataset_files.qmd#labdata.remote.dataset_files) | List the parts of a dataset at one commit. |
| [download](download.qmd#labdata.remote.download) | Stream one file's content from GitHub into a local path. |

## GitHub API

The client the GitHub backend reads with.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Client](Client.qmd#labdata.github.Client) | A thin, streaming client for the parts of the GitHub API labdata needs. |
| [token](token.qmd#labdata.github.token) | Find a GitHub token to authenticate with. |
| [blob_url](blob_url.qmd#labdata.github.blob_url) | Build a stable URL for one version of a published file. |
| [GitHubError](GitHubError.qmd#labdata.github.GitHubError) | Raised when GitHub cannot be read. |

## Manifests

The `labdata.yml` by which a repository states what it publishes, what
each published file holds, and, for a file published as a symbolic link,
which content that link stands for.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Manifest](Manifest.qmd#labdata.manifest.Manifest) | What one directory of a repository publishes. |
| [Stamp](Stamp.qmd#labdata.manifest.Stamp) | The content a published link stands for. |
| [parse](parse.qmd#labdata.manifest.parse) | Read a manifest. |
| [write_stamp](write_stamp.qmd#labdata.manifest.write_stamp) | Write one entry's stamp into a manifest, leaving the rest of the file alone. |
| [is_manifest](is_manifest.qmd#labdata.manifest.is_manifest) | Test whether a repository path is a manifest. |
| [manifest_path](manifest_path.qmd#labdata.manifest.manifest_path) | Where a results directory's manifest must sit to be read. |
| [ManifestError](ManifestError.qmd#labdata.manifest.ManifestError) | Raised when a manifest cannot be understood. |

## Configuration

Which directories are searched, which files are cataloged, and where
settings and the cache live.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Config](Config.qmd#labdata.config.Config) | Settings controlling which files are cataloged. |
| [use_config](use_config.qmd#labdata.config.use_config) | Register settings for the rest of the session, or for a block. |
| [active_config](active_config.qmd#labdata.config.active_config) | The settings in effect for calls that are not given any. |
| [Registration](Registration.qmd#labdata.config.Registration) | The undo for one call to [](`labdata.config.use_config`). |
| [config_path](config_path.qmd#labdata.config.config_path) | Location of the configuration file. |
| [cache_root](cache_root.qmd#labdata.config.cache_root) | Location of the local cache. |

## Cache

The content-addressed store, keyed by git blob sha, by Git LFS object
id, or by the stamp of a file published as a symbolic link.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [blob_path](blob_path.qmd#labdata.cache.blob_path) | Location of a cached object. |
| [readable_path](readable_path.qmd#labdata.cache.readable_path) | Location of the readable hard link for a cached object. |
| [store](store.qmd#labdata.cache.store) | Store an object held in memory. |
| [store_from_file](store_from_file.qmd#labdata.cache.store_from_file) | Store an object that already exists on disk, such as a Git LFS object. |
| [open_for_write](open_for_write.qmd#labdata.cache.open_for_write) | Prepare to stream an object into the cache. |
| [link](link.qmd#labdata.cache.link) | Expose a cached object under a readable name. |
| [objects](objects.qmd#labdata.cache.objects) | List every object the store holds. |
| [content_hash](content_hash.qmd#labdata.cache.content_hash) | Hash a file the way a manifest stamp records it. |
| [check_object](check_object.qmd#labdata.cache.check_object) | Test whether a cached object holds the content its key promises. |
| [discard](discard.qmd#labdata.cache.discard) | Remove a cached object, and the readable links that stand for it. |
| [usage](usage.qmd#labdata.cache.usage) | Measure how much the cache holds. |

## Git access

Plumbing wrappers used to read repositories.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [discover_repos](discover_repos.qmd#labdata.gitutil.discover_repos) | Find git working trees under a set of root directories. |
| [tracked_blobs](tracked_blobs.qmd#labdata.gitutil.tracked_blobs) | List files tracked at HEAD under a directory, with blob shas and sizes. |
| [tracked_entries](tracked_entries.qmd#labdata.gitutil.tracked_entries) | List everything tracked at HEAD under a directory, symbolic links included. |
| [head_commit](head_commit.qmd#labdata.gitutil.head_commit) | Read the commit a repository currently points at. |
| [file_history](file_history.qmd#labdata.gitutil.file_history) | List every commit that changed one file, newest first. |
| [blob_at](blob_at.qmd#labdata.gitutil.blob_at) | Find the blob sha and size of a file as of a revision. |
| [entry_at](entry_at.qmd#labdata.gitutil.entry_at) | Find the blob sha, size and mode of a file as of a revision. |
| [tree_at](tree_at.qmd#labdata.gitutil.tree_at) | Find the tree sha of a directory as of a revision. |
| [tree_files](tree_files.qmd#labdata.gitutil.tree_files) | List every file beneath a directory as of a revision. |
| [tag_map](tag_map.qmd#labdata.gitutil.tag_map) | Map commits to the tags pointing at them. |
| [read_blob](read_blob.qmd#labdata.gitutil.read_blob) | Read the content of a blob into memory. |
| [write_blob_to](write_blob_to.qmd#labdata.gitutil.write_blob_to) | Stream the content of a blob to a file. |
| [write_file_to](write_file_to.qmd#labdata.gitutil.write_file_to) | Copy a file that git does not hold, such as a Git LFS object. |
| [parse_lfs_pointer](parse_lfs_pointer.qmd#labdata.gitutil.parse_lfs_pointer) | Read a Git LFS pointer file. |
| [lfs_object_path](lfs_object_path.qmd#labdata.gitutil.lfs_object_path) | Locate the real content of a Git LFS object in a repository. |
| [link_target](link_target.qmd#labdata.gitutil.link_target) | Read where a committed symbolic link points. |
| [resolve_link](resolve_link.qmd#labdata.gitutil.resolve_link) | Locate the file a committed symbolic link points at. |
| [GitError](GitError.qmd#labdata.gitutil.GitError) | Raised when a git command fails. |

## Command line

Entry points behind the `labdata` command.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [main](main.qmd#labdata.cli.main) | Run the command line interface. |
| [table](table.qmd#labdata.cli.table) | Render rows as a plain text table with aligned columns. |
| [human](human.qmd#labdata.cli.human) | Format a byte count for display. |
| [note](note.qmd#labdata.cli.note) | Summarise what is unusual about a version, for the table's NOTE column. |
